name: element.text
description: Read the element's text content via TextPattern (preferred) or ValuePattern (fallback). Empty payload (`OK 0`) is valid.

x-output-schema.description: UTF-8 text content of the element. Length reported in the wire OK header (`OK <len>\n<bytes>`); empty body when the element has no text.

x-implementations.name: uia_text_pattern
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationTextPattern::DocumentRange.GetText(-1)` — preferred path; returns full document text including formatting-stripped runs.

x-implementations.name: uia_value_pattern
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationValuePattern::CurrentValue` — fallback for elements (Edit boxes, ComboBoxes) that expose ValuePattern but not TextPattern.

windows-modern.description: TextPattern preferred, ValuePattern fallback. Returns ERR not_supported_by_target if the element exposes neither pattern (rare for visible text-bearing elements, common for icon-only controls).
